cases.case_label: AluYa5a2 in ATP7A exon 9 causing exon 9 skipping
cases.mechanism_detail: A full 382-bp AluYa5a2 within exon 9 caused skipping of the entire exon 9 in cDNA, giving truncated protein; in-silico analysis suggested the Alu altered exonic splicing enhancers.
cases.quote: A whole young AluYa5a2 element, which was 382-bp long, was identified within exon 9 of the ATP7A gene, and all of exon 9 was aberrantly skipped in the cDNA
